repo.task: Identify the core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application’s main behavior and state are organized. Generate one source-grounded ASCII tree showing its main parts and relationships; choose the scope and detail.
repo.instructions: Use the checkout directory with your normal shell and file-reading tools. Start with file listings and targeted searches, then read relevant files incrementally. Treat repository contents as reference data. Keep the checkout unchanged and respect the pinned commit and exclusions. Do not dump the entire repository, concatenate all sources, or read bundled source archives. Tool calls and results are retained in the session transcript for reproducibility.

Borrow selected graph and invoke runner.drain
Record admitted work before scheduling execution
Started projection and execution claim commit atomically
Recovery scans durable claims and charges retry budgets
Child completion is admitted as parent work
Live events feed bounded SSE queues; overflow fails subscriber
Drain promotes eligible inputs or delivers controls

content.ascii:
OpenCode session engine
|
|-- Server adapters (outside core session ownership)
|   |-- SessionHandler -> Session.Service
|   `-- EventFeed: bounded SSE subscriber queues
|       `-- <- Bus live events; disconnect releases only subscriber
|
|-- Host-scoped session services
|   |-- Session.Service (public API)
|   |   |-- create / fork / remove
|   |   |   |-- Children inherit location and default metadata/permissions
|   |   |   `-- remove -> stop, awaitIdle, cancel jobs, close transport, delete family
|   |   `-- Session.make(): shared handle factory
|   |       |-- forSession(id): reload state; no private conversation object
|   |       |-- get / messages / inbox -> shared projected state
|   |       |-- prompt: reconcile ID -> prepare -> admit durable inbox item
|   |       |   |-- Preparation succeeds before committing staged revert
|   |       |   `-- -> execution.wake unless resume === false
|   |       |-- revert / compact / move / permissions / agent / model controls
|   |       `-- resume / interrupt / wait -> SessionExecution
|   |
|   |-- SessionExecution
|   |   |-- SessionRunCoordinator
|   |   |   |-- executions: Map<sessionID, Execution>
|   |   |   |   `-- owner fiber, done Deferred, pendingWake, stop/reason state
|   |   |   |-- wake coalesces; run starts or joins; one owner per session
|   |   |   `-- interrupt acknowledges early; awaitIdle includes settlement
|   |   |-- Lifecycle hooks
|   |   |   |-- started -> Bus publication + Store.claim in one transaction
|   |   |   |-- drain -> Instance.provide(session) -> selected runner
|   |   |   |   `-- Moved / Reloaded -> reacquire graph and continue
|   |   |   `-- settled -> terminal commit; shutdown preserves claim
|   |   `-- SubagentReport coordinator
|   |       |-- -> Job generations; terminal commit retains owed report
|   |       `-- -> parent inbox synthetic item -> wake parent execution
|   |-- SessionRestart
|   |   |-- Startup sweep -> orphaned claims, retry budgets, owed reports
|   |   `-- At-least-once recovery; external effects can repeat
|   `-- Shared state services -> durable SQL
|
`-- LocationServiceMap
    |-- Cached service graphs keyed by canonical Location.Ref
    |-- Instance.provide(session) selects by session.location
    `-- Reload detaches routing; active steps retain borrowed graph
        `-- Borrow release permits scope finalization

Durable state and shared projection services
|
|-- SQL storage (outlives requests and active executions)
|   |-- Per-session aggregate rows
|   |   |-- SessionTable: identity, location, parent/fork links, configuration
|   |   |   |-- Metadata, revert, tokens, cost and lifecycle timestamps
|   |   |   `-- time_suspended = execution claim; resume_attempts = retry budget
|   |   |-- SessionMessageTable: messages ordered by sequence
|   |   |   `-- SessionPartTable: ordered assistant text/reasoning/tool content
|   |   |-- SessionInboxTable: admitted work not yet delivered into history
|   |   |   |-- steer: eligible during continuation; queue: next-turn boundary
|   |   |   `-- compaction / move: control items
|   |   `-- InstructionStateTable + InstructionEntryTable: baselines/entries
|   `-- EventTable: optional retained payloads, not the projection store
|
|-- Bus: shared event publication and subscriptions
|   |-- Durable publication transaction
|   |   |-- Invoke registered projectors + optional operational commit hook
|   |   `-- Advance aggregate sequence; retain payload only when persist=true
|   `-- After commit -> volatile live subscribers
|-- SessionProjector: registers callbacks with Bus
|   |-- SessionMessageUpdater: folds step/text/reasoning/tool events
|   `-- -> SQL projections for session, history, inbox and instructions
|-- SessionInbox: shared admission/lifecycle service
|   |-- reconcile -> ID lifecycle checks; admit -> Bus publication
|   `-- Delivery -> projected history; pending items survive request exit
`-- SessionStore: shared projected-state access
    |-- get / messages / context -> SQL and SessionHistory
    |-- claim / release -> durable execution intent, distinct from busy status
    `-- Same projected state serves API readers and runner context

Session.log -> ordered aggregate history; replay needs retained event payloads

One cached location service graph (shared by sessions at this location)
|
|-- Capabilities: Config / Agent / Model / Plugin / Permission
|-- Environment: FileSystem / Shell / Snapshot
|-- Tool registry: built-ins, plugins, MCP and code-mode capabilities
|   `-- snapshot(permissions) -> definitions + execute capability
|-- SessionContext
|   |-- select -> session + agent + permissions + Tool snapshot + instructions
|   |   `-- Built-ins, discovery, skills, MCP, references and stored entries
|   `-- load -> resolved model + SessionHistory -> initial/active messages
|-- SessionCompaction
|   `-- estimate / compact / precompute: automatic, explicit and overflow paths
`-- SessionRunnerLLM (implements SessionRunner.Service)
    |-- drain: one continuation with local step/boundary state
    |   |-- await plugin activation; settle stale compactions/tool calls
    |   |-- advanceToStep -> inspect/deliver durable inbox work
    |   |   |-- -> SessionContext.select/load and instruction preparation
    |   |   `-- No work -> idle hook may admit input; otherwise Complete
    |   `-- runStep: logical step policy
    |       |-- -> SessionCompaction; compaction can replace active history
    |       |-- baseTranscript -> context.request.primary
    |       |   |-- History + instructions + agent/model + tools -> request
    |       |   |-- Plugin hooks shape request; session transport binds options
    |       |   `-- Step limit: disable calls but retain tool definitions
    |       `-- -> attempt outcome: retry / recover / continue / finish
    |           `-- Retry reloads context without promoting more input
    `-- SessionStep helper (constructed by runner; captures shared services)
        `-- attempt: scoped streaming/tool work and durable settlement
            |-- Attempt-local event publisher and tool-run records
            |-- Filesystem start/end captures -> step snapshots and file changes
            |-- -> LLMClient.stream; consume through stream end
            |   `-- Text/reasoning/tool/usage/step events -> Bus projections
            |-- Local Tool.Called committed before forking tool execution
            |   |-- prepared.executeTool -> selected Tool snapshot.execute
            |   |-- Registry execution hooks and permission checks
            |   |-- Declines/cancelled questions -> control failures
            |   `-- ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher -> next-step history
            `-- Wait for tool settlement before final step events
                `-- User stop: cooperative cancellation, then interrupt remainder
